author: John Doe
content:
In an era defined by the persistent hum of digital notifications and the relentless pull of the attention economy, silence has become the ultimate luxury. We are no longer just consumers of information; we are its targets. To find focus today is not merely a productivity hack—it is an act of architectural resistance.
